audience: hotel and vacation rental teams that handle arrivals, check-ins and folios in Rentlio

useCases.title: See today's arrivals and their units
useCases.text: List the reservations active today at a property, with arrival and departure dates and the unit.

useCases.title: Check a reservation's folio balance
useCases.text: Read one reservation in full, then list its folios with the balances and every charge line.

useCases.title: Find guests checked in this week
useCases.text: List the guests checked in at a property between two check-in dates.

useCases.title: Filter reservations by unit or date
useCases.text: List reservations by property, unit, status or date. Give both dateFrom and dateTo, or neither.

useCases.title: Check in a guest and add a note
useCases.text: Check in a reservation, then add a note such as a late arrival. Both calls change the reservation in Rentlio.
